U.note: Pigment-bowl mixer with a glyph blob and paint/light modes is on-brief, but the dark, dim glyphs are barely visible at rest and the mix reads weakly.

V.note: Full painting canvas with RGB sliders, three mix modes and a two-colour mixer is rich, though it opens mostly empty and has many controls.

W.note: Clean two-colour ratio mixer with a glyph ramp, command prompt and mean versus linear modes; it is focused but narrow and less playful.

X.note: Bowl-and-brush design is sound, but the blank black canvas has a faint dot grid that only fills part of its width, and clicking a pigment shows no visible result.

Y.note: Polished dark UI with pigment pots, paint/light/naive models and a pre-painted colourful ASCII grid, so the mixing shows at once; the grid is drawable.

Z.note: Compact, well-made A/B mixer with a shaded glyph preview, a hex readout and full keyboard shortcuts, but it only mixes two colours.
